mapper.select: SELECT p.id_paquete AS idPaquete, p.descripcion AS descripcion, p.peso AS peso, p.alto AS alto, p.ancho AS ancho, p.profundidad AS profundidad, p.id_envio AS idEnvio, e.numero_guia AS numeroGuia FROM paquete p JOIN envio e ON p.id_envio = e.id_envio;

SELECT p.id_paquete AS idPaquete, p.descripcion AS descripcion, p.peso AS peso, p.alto AS alto, p.ancho AS ancho, p.profundidad AS profundidad, p.id_envio AS idEnvio FROM paquete AS p WHERE p.id_envio = #{value};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paquete ( descripcion, peso, alto, ancho, profundidad, id_envio ) VALUES ( #{descripcion}, #{peso}, #{alto}, #{ancho}, #{profundidad}, #{idEnvio} );
mapper.update: UPDATE paquete SET descripcion = #{descripcion}, peso = #{peso}, alto = #{alto}, ancho = #{ancho}, profundidad = #{profundidad} WHERE id_paquete = #{idPaquete};
